record.bible_text: Now Jehoram<WH03088> the son<WH01121> of Ahab<WH0256> began to reign<WH04427><WTH8804> over Israel<WH03478> in Samaria<WH08111> the eighteenth<WH08083><WH06240> year<WH08141> of Jehoshaphat<WH03092> king<WH04428> of Judah<WH03063>, and reigned<WH04427><WTH8799> twelve<WH08147><WH06240> years<WH08141>.
